title: Folding Blue & Grey Step Stool $4.90 + Delivery ($0 Pickup / $120 Spend) @ Spotlight
body:
Deal: Folding Blue & Grey Step Stool $4.90 + Delivery ($0 Pickup / $120 Spend) @ Spotlight

[BestTechAdvisor] Had one of these in a caravan and it was very handy. Would probably be very useful in campervans and SUVs with roof racks too.
[montorola] It's ok, get one per leg and turn that :( into :)
[MattyD] Your imagination weighs 100kg?
That’s impressive.
[schquid] Grab the handrail accessory kit as well. Purchase both in one transaction and receive a free profuse sweat towel for free.
[ATangk] I remember when these were mass introduced during in the 2008 world expo… Everyone had them for the super long queues.
[MrZ] 100kg weight limit wtf? That rules out about 10% of the population (including myself).
[Domingo] Or it caters for about 90% of the population
[MrZ] Not really good enough. Would you make a car that only 90% of people can fit in? Or a door way that only 90% can fit under?
[QuickToThePointless] do what they say. have a few for around the home - they used to be sold as anko for around this price
perfect for top of wardrobe storage crates/shoe boxes etc
[ihatemyjob] Don’t forget CC - Bonus $5 in-store voucher when placing Click and Collect order.
[TerryTightwad] Bought one of these for $6 the other day at the reject shop. Now I feel ripped off.
[2027] I dunno, it kinda looks Grey & Blue to me.
What’s with the bait and switch, I am still looking for a Blue & Grey stool.
[anonym] I think I can see gold if I squint my eyes juuuust right.
[aboabo] There are taller ones too. https://www.kmart.com.au/product/boxsweden-foldaway-large-st…
[anonym] Sold by a third party on Kmart website, $19.05 plus $9.95 delivery is a tad expensive.
[aboabo] True, but my link was for the consideration of extra short people.
[Spending2Much] The taller one at Spotlight also….I bought the taller one with a $5 spotlight C&C voucher I had laying round. (Cheaper than Kmart too)
https://www.spotlightstores.com/en-au/p/boxsweden-foldaway-l…
[rehan770] Not sure when I clicked it showed me $5 & when proceeding to check out it changed into $7. Still worth.
